entries.heading: FILING REQUIREMENT FOR PUBLIC FILING PRIOR TO PUBLIC OFFERING
ancestors: TITLE LXXI—IMPROVING ACCESS TO CAPITAL FOR EMERGING GROWTH COMPANIES
entries.text:
SEC. 71001. FILING REQUIREMENT FOR PUBLIC FILING PRIOR TO PUBLIC 
                            OFFERING.

    Section 6(e)(1) of the Securities Act of 1933 (15 U.S.C. 77f(e)(1)) 
is amended by striking ``21 days'' and inserting ``15 days''.
